Subject: Quick intro + tight CIO/CTO slot for PoC demo

Hi Tessa —

Thanks again for the quick sync last week. We're excited to move to a short, focused executive demo to help our CIO (Michael) and CTO (Priya) see the flow end-to-end before procurement kicks off. Our execs only have a 40–45 minute evening window next Tuesday (4/6) 5:00–5:45pm PT.

Can Redwood run a tight 20–25 minute run-through (highlighting latency/cost controls and private deployment options) followed by a 15–20 minute Q&A? If that works, I’ll lock the slot and send the calendar invite.

Attached is a proposed agenda — it’s intentionally lean. Also, procurement may ask for SOC2 evidence after the exec call; flagged so we can surface the right contact.

Agenda attachment: zephyrus-demo-agenda.pdf

Best,

Subject: Internal: run order + dry-run slots for Zephyrus exec demo

Tessa / Kim — planning notes for the run:

1) Run order (25/15):
   - 00:00–02:00 Quick hello / intro (Tessa)
   - 02:00–10:00 Platform overview & model catalog (Ben)
   - 10:00–20:00 Dedicated + Private demo (Ben) — show routing, quantization profiles, and token-level cost breakdown
   - 20:00–25:00 TL;DR on fallbacks & SLA (Kimberly covers security/compliance ask)
   - 25:00–45:00 Open Q&A (Tessa/Kim)

2) Dry-run: candidate slots on Tue 4/6: 3:00–3:20pm PT or 3:30–3:50pm PT. I prefer 3:30 if Zephyrus can match.

3) Recording: prepare a short shareable clip path (helpful for internal stakeholders who can’t attend).

4) Logistics: I’ll bring the demo VM image that uses the Zephyrus sample workload. Need confirmation on whether they want any IP masked for the demo (if so, we’ll toggle sample dataset).

Action items: Tessa — ask Jordan to confirm recording preference and lock calendar. Kim — I’ll queue the SOC2 summary slide and a redacted evidence pointer.

—Ben
